item.title: CTeen Brings Jewish Pride to the Streets of New York
item.description: You couldn't miss them. Across all five boroughs, the iconic CTeen beanies became a sea of color and identity, on the subway, at the Statue of Liberty, at the Empire State Building, at the Ohel. Thousands of Jewish teens, unmistakably proud, unmistakably together. Full Story, Photos
